title: When the Kitchen Burns
author: Paloma Reyes
blurb: Felix Ashgrove, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the bakery lease runs out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
